name: work in a scaled residue form so that reduction becomes a multiply and a shift
mechanism: represent every residue multiplied by a power of the machine radix; then reducing a product modulo the odd modulus needs only a multiplication by a precomputed inverse and a shift, never a trial division; convert in once and out once

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Montgomery reduction' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Elementary and special functions: an algorithm that allows modular arithmetic to be performed efficiently when the modulus is large

requires: one precomputed inverse of the modulus modulo the radix
fails_when: a single operation is not cheaper; only a chain of them pays for the conversions
